problems.explain: There are 6 × 6 = 36 equally likely ordered pairs. The ones that give a sum of 4 or less are (1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 1), (2, 2), (3, 1): 6/36 = 1/6. ((1, 2) and (2, 1) are different rolls, so both count; the 11 possible sums are not equally likely.) So 1/6.
